prompt: A squat domed ossuary shrine built entirely of stacked human skulls and weathered bone, mortared with grey mud, standing in a fetid black-water swamp. Tendrils of dark necrotic energy and a faint sickly violet-black glow seep from the eye sockets and gaps between the bones, dripping down into the murky water. The structure is a man-made bone reliquary, wide and low, its skulls bleached bone-white and lichen-stained. The background is a gloomy moss-draped cypress swamp at dusk, with stagnant black water reflecting the necrotic glow.

An ornate reliquary casket of carved bone and blackened iron resting on a cracked stone plinth in a swamp, its heavy lid ajar. Thick black necromantic mist and a sickly violet glow pour out of the open casket and spill across the stagnant water around the plinth. The casket is decorated with rows of small skulls and verdigris-bronze fittings. The background is a dark cypress bog at twilight with hanging moss and black still water.
